test_admin_sidebar_tabs_visible.title: Verify the admin header lists its tabs in order

steps.action: Open Admin and read the header's tab labels left to right.
steps.expected: Sites, Users and General appear in that order among Dashboard, Sites, Users, Maps, Integrations, Rules, General, LPR and Licenses.

test_navigate_to_general.title: Verify clicking General tab opens the General section

steps.action: Click the General tab.
steps.expected: General is painted as the selected tab and its cards are listed: Deployment, Audit Trail, System Logs, Multi-Factor Authentication and Event Wall.

steps.expected: User is logged in and default page loads

steps.action: Navigate to Admin > General
steps.expected: General page loads without errors

steps.expected: All data sections have loaded completely

steps.action: Locate General section contains Rules sub-tab on the page
steps.expected: General section contains Rules sub-tab is visible in the expected location

steps.action: Verify the data values are populated and not empty or showing placeholders
steps.expected: Actual data values are displayed (not 'N/A', 'Loading...', or '---')

steps.action: Verify the data format is correct (numbers, dates, labels, etc.)
steps.expected: Data is formatted according to the expected display format

steps.action: Verify General section contains Rules sub-tab is displayed as expected
steps.expected: General section contains Rules sub-tab is displayed as expected

steps.action: Refresh the page and verify the data displays consistently
steps.expected: Same data appears after page refresh

test_general_section_has_audit_trail.title: Verify the General section's Audit Trail card

steps.action: Open Admin > General and read the Audit Trail card.
steps.expected: Its blurb starts "Monitor and review all activities" and it carries one View button.

test_general_section_has_event_wall.title: Verify the General section's Event Wall card

steps.action: Open Admin > General and read the Event Wall card.
steps.expected: Its blurb reads "Manage event wall configuration." and it carries one View button.

test_switch_users_to_sites.title: Verify switching from Users tab to Sites tab works

steps.action: Open Admin > Users, then click Sites.
steps.expected: Sites is painted as the selected tab, Users is not, and the Sites search field shows its Search placeholder.

steps.expected: The element is visible and interactive

steps.action: Verify switching from Sites tab to General tab works is displayed and functions correctly
steps.expected: Switching from sites tab to general tab works is displayed as expected

steps.action: Verify the UI responded correctly to the interaction
steps.expected: Visual feedback confirms the action was processed

test_round_trip_users_general_users.title: Verify navigating Users -> General -> Users round-trip works

steps.action: Open Admin > Users, click General, then click Users again.
steps.expected: Users is painted as the selected tab, General is not, and the Add User button is back.

test_open_audit_trail.title: Verify the Audit Trail card's View button opens the audit log

steps.action: Open Admin > General and click View on the Audit Trail card.
steps.expected: The breadcrumb reads General > Audit Trail and the table's columns are Username, Role Type, Date & Time, IP and Action.

steps.expected: The address still ends in /admin and the header lists Sites, Users and General in that order.
